build_system: Gradle 8.x with Kotlin DSL (android/). Python: pip with requirements.txt. No root-level Gradle wrapper — all Android commands run from android/ subdirectory using ./gradlew
test_framework: Android: JUnit 4 + Robolectric (unit), Espresso + Compose UI (instrumented). Backend: pytest with pytest-cov
build_command: cd android && ./gradlew assembleLocalDebug (after flavors added); currently ./gradlew assembleDebug
test_command: Android: cd android && ./gradlew testLocalDebugUnitTest (after flavors); currently ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest. Backend: cd backend && pytest --cov=app --cov-fail-under=90
verification_instructions: Android: run ./gradlew testLocalDebugUnitTest testCloudDebugUnitTest from android/. Backend: run pytest from backend/ with ENV=local DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///:memory: JWT_SECRET=test-only.
snapshot_or_generated_files: android/app/schemas/ — Room schema JSON files generated by KSP. Produced by ./gradlew kspLocalDebugKotlin. These are committed.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine (PowerShell). Android Gradle wrapper is at android/gradlew (not root). Backend dir currently contains only .gitkeep — fully greenfield. No docker-compose.yml at root. No network_security_config.xml exists yet. The gitignore already covers .env, .env.local, .env.*.local but NOT backend/.env.local or backend/.env.cloud specifically.
contribution_requirements: All Gradle deps must use exact pinned versions in libs.versions.toml. No secrets in any Kotlin source, resource, or committed config file. Synthetic data only in tests. No backend code outside backend/. No Android code outside android/. Tests must pass in CI.
key_patterns: build.gradle.kts reads local.properties using rootProject.file('local.properties') and Properties(). BuildConfig fields use buildConfigField(). Existing BACKEND_BASE_URL field must be REPLACED (not kept alongside) by the new per-flavor API_BASE_URL field. Android package is com.medihistory.ai. Application class is MediHistoryApplication. AppConfig goes in com.medihistory.ai.config package (new package, no existing files). Backend is greenfield — create minimum foundation only.
directory_structure: MediHistory-AI/ root contains android/, backend/ (only .gitkeep), docs/, .kiro/, .github/workflows/. Android source is android/app/src/main/java/com/medihistory/ai/. UI theme is in ui/theme/. No config/ package exists yet. No flavor source sets exist yet. docs/ has architecture/, design/, jira/, product/, security/ — but NO deployment/ subdirectory yet.
